roles.title: Account Executive
requirements: Postgraduate degree in Public Relations, Communications, Marketing, or a related field
Previous internship experience in public relations
Solid understanding of the media landscape
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
Ability to multitask and manage projects seamlessly
responsibilities: Develop and execute PR strategies aligned with business objectives across industries (Consumer, Corporate, FMCG, Luxury, Retail, Lifestyle, Beauty, Real Estate)
Cultivate and maintain relationships with media professionals, influencers, and industry leaders
Craft press releases, media kits, and engaging content
Manage and respond to media inquiries and foster influencer relations
Monitor, analyze, and report on media coverage and PR campaign performance
Organize media events, press conferences, and product launches
Stay updated on industry trends and leverage emerging PR opportunities
